summary: Corrected weak tests from iteration85 and validated load test scripts. Fixed test_catalog_history_per_set_not_truncated_200 (set2 started_at now-100), test_preflight_deduplicates_identical_refs (real repeated refs with spy on render_crop), test_preflight_validates_all_unique_refs_including_invalid (invalid ref last not first), test_book_view_full_vs_projected_equality (full ChapterView comparison). Fixed catalog_smoke.py and bson_bytes_benchmark.py parents path bug (parents[3]->parents[2]). All 48 packet1 tests pass. Load scripts execute successfully with proper guardrails. Verified ChapterBookStudio uses preview.chapter.id (not null) and Auth loads secrets from .env (no inline credentials).
passed_tests: test_catalog_history_per_set_not_truncated_200: Corrected set2 started_at to now-100 (older than all 250 set1 attempts)
test_preflight_deduplicates_identical_refs: Added real repeated refs (100 refs, 2 unique file_ids) with spy on render_crop, validates exactly 2 distinct refs per request
test_preflight_validates_all_unique_refs_including_invalid: Invalid ref now appears last (i==50) after good refs
test_book_view_full_vs_projected_equality: Full ChapterView comparison excluding only server_now
catalog_smoke.py: 40 requests, 100% success, p50=66.8ms, p95=76.25ms, p99=199.43ms, 5.04 rps
bson_bytes_benchmark.py: 95 chapter sets, 97.09% bytes saved (5.8MB -> 169KB) with BOOK_CHAPTER_PROJECT
ChapterBookStudio: Verified Dialog onOpenChange correctly sets selected=null, base URL uses preview.chapter.id (prevents /chapters/null)
Auth: Verified no inline secrets, credentials loaded from user input not hardcoded

test_corrections.test_catalog_history_per_set_not_truncat: Changed set2 started_at from now+300 to now-100 so it's older than all 250 set1 attempts (which start at now+i). This ensures the OLD implementation would FAIL, not PASS.
test_corrections.test_preflight_deduplicates_identical_re: Replaced empty refs with real repeated refs: 50 questions with 2 distinct file_ids (file_id_1 for q_refs, file_id_2 for s_refs) = 100 total refs but only 2 unique. Added spy on render_crop to assert exactly 2 distinct refs validated from 100 original refs, AND 2 again on second request (no cross-request caching).
test_corrections.test_preflight_validates_all_unique_refs: Moved invalid_file_id from i==1 (first question) to i==50 (last question) so invalid unique ref appears LAST after good first refs and raises, not first.
test_corrections.test_book_view_full_vs_projected_equalit: Changed from checking only few fields (count, title) to actually comparing full ChapterView of full docs vs projected using chapter_view() function, excluding only server_now which varies.

load_script_fixes.catalog_smoke.py: Fixed parents[3] -> parents[2] to correctly resolve /app root. Added try-catch for git HEAD retrieval. Script validates guardrails: 1..100 requests, 1..4 workers, finite 1..5 rps, 110sec wall limit, error RetryAfter, raw samples, versions, monotonic durations, nearest rank.
load_script_fixes.bson_bytes_benchmark.py: Fixed parents[3] -> parents[2] in two locations to correctly resolve /app root.

test_execution_summary.frontend_code_review: ChapterBookStudio.js line 66: Dialog onOpenChange={v=>!v&&setSelected(null)} correctly nulls selected on close, base URL uses preview.chapter.id. Auth.js: No inline secrets found, credentials from user input.
